title: How Earnings Accrue on the Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan
content:
**Accrued net earnings of a Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan pay period come only from the employer feed; a worker's statement of hours never adds to them.**

## Sync lines

*(This clause is no longer in force for the bank accrued net of a next-business-day bank transfer under the bank transfer amount schedule, where a regular-hours or shift-differential line estimated from gross may be valued as that schedule provides; for every other purpose it is in force and reads as follows.)* Each sync line adds its net amount for one work date and earnings source: the employer-reported net where the employer sends one, and otherwise the gross amount multiplied by the tier's gross-to-net estimation percentage, rounded down to the cent, with the net basis marked estimated from gross.

*Hypothetical:* a line reported at a gross of 93.33 USD only, at 70 percent, is 65.331 USD, rounded down to 65.33 USD.

## Which earnings accrue

*(This clause is no longer in force for the bank accrued net under the bank transfer amount schedule, where overtime lines and card tips lines count in the part that schedule provides; for every other purpose it is in force and reads as follows.)* Regular hours always accrue; overtime accrues when the tier counts overtime, shift differential when the tier counts shift differential, and card tips reported by the employer's point-of-sale feed only when the tier counts card tips; cash tips never accrue.

## Timing, corrections and period close

- A work date and earnings source is synced once per plan.
- A line counts toward the access base only from the tier's earnings availability lag in calendar days after its work date.
- A timecard correction from the employer removes the corrected net as a correction line for the same work date and payday; when a correction exceeds what the period's transfers leave room for, transfers already booked stand and only new transfers are limited.
- On payday a period close removes the period's whole remaining accrued net and accrual for the next pay period starts at zero.

| Earnings source | Accrues |
|---|---|
| Regular hours | always |
| Overtime hours | when the tier counts overtime |
| Shift differential | when the tier counts shift differential |
| Card tips from the point-of-sale feed | only when the tier counts card tips |
| Cash tips | never |

superseded_clauses: Each sync line adds its net_amount for one work date and earnings source: the employer-reported net where the employer sends one, and otherwise gross_amount multiplied by gross_to_net_estimation_percent, rounded down to the cent, with net_basis estimated_from_gross.

Regular hours always accrue; overtime accrues when overtime_included_in_accrual is true, shift differential when shift_differential_included_in_accrual is true, and card tips reported by the employer's point-of-sale feed only when tips_included_in_accrual is true; cash tips never accrue.
